reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives represent a layered approach to securing state transitions and access control. Secure entitlement resolution ensures that premium content is never exposed unless explicitly allowed, by enforcing tier-based filtering at the database layer. Race-free update patterns prevent race conditions in mutable game states, particularly around settling picks, which could lead to inconsistent or overwritten data. Paid call guards enforce that paid data sources are only accessed when justified, preventing unauthorized usage. These primitives together form a minimal yet robust kernel of security logic that operates under strong assumptions about atomicity and access control. Failure modes include bypassing entitlement checks or allowing concurrent writes to settled rows. The dual nature of these fixes—some committed, some uncommitted—reflects a pragmatic balance between immediate correctness and future integration.
